development_protocol: One deterministic512center crop per development image, no flips, positions chosen without labels
selection_metric: Pooled development person/rider/bicycle meanIoU, lower LR wins exact ties
undefined_score_rule: Ignore undefined VRU trials; if every trial undefined, predeclared fallback to meanIoU over present class unions; disclose fallback

split.recording_family_rule: Within condition, GOPR#### and GPxx#### share recording_####; unmatched names remain unchanged
split.split_rule: Within each condition, conservatively merge GoPro chapters by recording number, seed-shuffle families, then use dynamic programming to select a nonempty proper family subset nearest20%image count; equal-distance count ties favor more development images and equal-count subset ties favor lexicographically earliest seeded-family indices
split.split_limitation: Few large recording families can make the development fraction differ substantially from20%; recording grouping cannot prove geographic or scene independence

refit_rule: Fresh seeded head initialization on all1600 training images for5epochs, batch4; discard all trial weights
